BOARD RESOLUTION NO. _ 383
SERIES OF 2026

MODIFICATION OF PUBLIC UTILITY JEEPNEY (PUJ) ROUTE: LAGRO - CUBAO
VIA KALAYAAN

WHEREAS, the Department of ‘Transportation (DO'l'r) issued Department Order
(DO) No. 2023-022 providing for the guidelines on the implementation of the Public
Transport Modernization Program;

WHEREAS, on 30 April 2024, the Board issued MC No. 2024-009 (Re: Evaluation
Guidelines for Modification of Existing Routes) which provided the guidelines for the
evaluation of modification of Inter-Regional and Inter-Provincial (IRIP) routes and
MUCEP routes;

WHEREAS, the route Lagro - Cubao via Kalayaan is an existing Public Utility
Jeepney (PUJ) Route;

WHEREAS, Tolfetano Corp., an operator operating in the aforementioned route,
has requested route modification to ensure its viability as weli as to provide
convenience to the riding public;

WHEREAS, under Section 5(a) of Executive Order No. 202, the Board has the
power to prescribe and regulate routes of service, economically viable capacities and
zones or areas of operation of public land transportation service provided by motorized
vehicles;

WHEREAS, there is an urgent need to augment public transportation services to
address the growing demand of commuters, and ensure the availability of safe and
reliable transport options, hence the timely implementation of enhanced transport
routes and services;

NOW, THEREFORE, in view of the foregoing, the Board hereby APPROVES the
MODIFICATION of the PUJ route Lagro - Cubao via Kalayaan to Lagro (Hilltop) -
Stop & Shop as detailed in Annex “A”, subject tc the result of the Route Rationalization
Study.

The operator of the route Lagro - Cubao via Kalayaan under Case Number
NCR-PUJ-2018-06-00076 now modified as Lagro (Hilltop) - Stop & Shop is DIRECTED
to file an APPLICATION FOR MODIFICATION OF ROUTE pursuant to this Board
Resolution within six (6) months upon issuance of this Resolution and to obtain the
adjusted fare guide from the LTFRB RFRO-NCR. Failure to comply shall be a « ‘pTze for
revocation of this Board Resolution. pe:
